comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record frees a jammed bottle from a capper starwheel and rejects it.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine latch access and simultaneous tool-wire pull versus reversing an indexed wheel before grasping and relocating a bottle.
comparison.success_condition: Selected terminal alone exits intact versus wheel first reversed at least 6 degrees, never advanced improperly, and bottle released upright in the bin.
comparison.reason: The record tests jam-clearance sequencing and object recovery, not extraction from a locking cavity.
